title: Free But First Coffee Printable Wall Art
excerpt: A free but first coffee printable you can download, print on cardstock, and frame for your coffee corner in an afternoon, no shipping and no thirty-dollar store sign.
quick_answer: A but first coffee printable is a digital art file of the phrase "but first, coffee" that you download and print at home, then frame for your coffee station. It costs a few dollars of paper and ink instead of twenty-five to forty dollars for a shipped, store-bought sign, and you can reprint it anytime.
seo_title: But First Coffee Printable Wall Art (Free Download)
seo_description: Free but first coffee printable wall art: download, print on cardstock, and frame your coffee corner today. Sizes 5x7, 8x10, and 11x14, no sign-up.

faq_items.question: What size should I print a but first coffee sign?
faq_items.answer: Match the size to the spot. A 5x7 suits a bar cart, mug shelf, or desk; an 8x10 fits nicely above the coffee maker; and an 11x14 anchors a larger blank wall or a breakfast nook. Most downloads include all three sizes in one file.

faq_items.question: What paper should I use to print coffee wall art at home?
faq_items.answer: Use medium-weight matte cardstock, around 60-80 lb (160-216 gsm), for a gallery look that holds color and will not ripple in a frame. Plain printer paper works in a pinch, but cardstock is what separates a homemade page from a store-bought print.

faq_items.question: How do I print a but first coffee printable without cutting off the edges?
faq_items.answer: In your print dialog, choose "actual size" or "100 percent" instead of "fit to page," which quietly shrinks the image and adds uneven borders. Set quality to best or photo, and run one test on plain paper first to check the framing before using cardstock.

faq_items.question: Is the but first coffee printable really free?
faq_items.answer: Yes. You download the PDF, print as many copies as you like, and frame it with something you already own. There is no watermark and no per-copy fee, so decorating your coffee corner costs only a few cents of paper and ink instead of a shipped store sign.

faq_items.question: Where does a but first coffee print look best?
faq_items.answer: Above or beside the coffee station is the natural home, whether that is a counter nook, a bar cart, or the mug shelf. It also suits a breakfast corner, a home-office desk, or a breakroom. Hang it so the center sits about 57-60 inches from the floor.
